description: This Java class is responsible for deserializing JSON input data related to 'fund' commands in the Apache Fineract project. It validates incoming JSON for create and update operations, ensuring required fields are present and conform to constraints.

classes.name: FundCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A Spring component that deserializes and validates JSON representations of fund commands, supporting create and update operations.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a fund, ensuring required parameters are present and within constraints.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating a fund, allowing optional parameters and validating their constraints.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any data validation errors are detected.
